rv.q: The production, directed by Declan Donnellan, achieves moments of surprising emotional intensity, particularly in its final act, when the play's multiple plot threads begin to coalesce into something approaching coherence.
The performers work very hard to put it all over, and for the most part they succeed.

Daffier than those of other period romances, its complex plot is kept comprehensible thanks to a sure-footed cast that includes Lily Rabe and Hamish Linklater as the put-upon lovers Imogen and Posthumus...The two share an on-stage chemistry that's clearly informed by their offstage relationship...Rabe's Imogen, here, is endearing...Linklater...
